items.title: Cam Skattebo: Not doing much at Friday's practice
items.text:
Skattebo (hamstring) was in uniform but not participating at the start of Friday's practice, Jordan Raanan of ESPN reports.

items.title: Emeka Egbuka: Could be game-time call
items.text:
Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said Friday that Egbuka (foot) will be a game-time decision for Sunday night's game against the Bears, Greg Auman of Fox Sports reports.

items.title: TreVeyon Henderson: Provides medical update Friday
items.text:
In a statement posted to social media on Friday, Henderson -- who hasn't practiced since last Wednesday -- noted that he recently experienced "an unexpected and unusual medical emergency involving a series of unexplained neurological symptoms," Mike Reiss of ESPN reports.
